task.title: Entitled to parental benefits — Continuing claim

step.cmd: Determine if the type of parental benefits requested or the number of entitlement weeks must be changed:
Determine if an MA01 is imposed for the parental benefits sharing issue and if there is a related registration number:

ul.li: If an MA01 is imposed but there is no registration number, go to step 3.
If an MA01 is imposed and there is a revised registration number, go to step 4.
If an MA01 is not imposed but there is a revised registration number, go to step 5.
If none of the above applies, go to step 10.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and remove the MA01 as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Manual Action: Select 1 - General suspension of benefits (stop payment) .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete the following fields:

ul.li: Claim Allowed: Select NCA - No changes to the claim .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is an outstanding registration number for the benefits sharing issue:

ul.li: If there is a registration number, go to step 7.

If there is no registration number, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .
Go to step 7.

step.cmd: Determine the type of change being made:

ul.li: If the type of parental benefits the client is entitled to must be changed, go to step 8.
If only the number of weeks must be changed, go to step 16.

step.cmd: Determine the type of benefit change being made:

ul.li: If the change is from standard to extended parental benefits, the claim type (CT) is 3 - Sickness major attached or 4 - Maternity or parental and no parental benefits have been paid, go to step 9.
If the change is from standard to extended parental benefits and the claim type is 14 - Standard parental , the request must be completed by IPOC. Go to step 10.
If the change is from extended to standard parental benefits, the request must be completed by IPOC. Go to step 13.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and do the following:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

Select the Special Benefits (M106) link and enter the following information in the Parental section:
Entitlement weeks: Enter the number of weeks of extended parental benefits the client is requesting.
Select Save .

Waiting period:
If the WP was deferred in error, select X - Rescind .
If the WP was not deferred but should be, select 5 – Waiting period deferred (parental standard or extended) .
Supplementary claim information: Select 99 - Parental extended .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
Work type: Select 60 - Rejected transaction / or situation not otherwise listed that must be processed via purge and recreate.
Remarks line 1: Type “Change from standard to extended parental benefits.”
Remarks line 2: Type “Change to CT 16, APW [XXXX], PSW [XXXX], ENT WKS [XX].”
Remarks line 3: Type “Natural/Adoption Code [X], NO-CR (if requested by client), WP deferral (type “yes” if required or “rescind” if it was deferred in error).”
Remarks line 4: Type “Add the extended parental benefits flag.”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
Work type: Select 60 - Rejected transaction / or situation not otherwise listed that must be processed via purge and recreate .
Remarks line 1: Type “Change from extended to standard parental benefits.”
Remarks line 2: Type “Change to CT 14, APW [XXXX], PSW [XXXX], ENT WKS [XX].”
Remarks line 3: Type “Natural/Adoption Code [X], NO-CR (if requested by client), WP deferral (type “yes” if required or “rescind” if it was deferred in error).”
Remarks line 4: Type “Rescind the extended parental benefits flag.”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .

step.cmd: Select the Registration number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete the following fields:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

Select the Special Benefits (M106) link and in the Parental section, do the following:
Entitlement weeks: Enter the number of weeks of entitlement (the total number of weeks the client is entitled to, including weeks already paid).
Select Save .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the N-00-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Maternity and/or parental benefits (standard/extended) approved or denied with sickness options (3054)
Right to Request a Reconsideration (with Blank option) (4169): Select Right to Request a Reconsideration .

step.cmd: If the client is entitled to fewer weeks than requested, verbally communicate the decision to the client.
In NWS, complete the WI for the benefits sharing issue.
